department: College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences

deadline.value: The application deadline is December 1. The page gives no year, so the 2026/27 cycle is used.

also.quote: This program starts only in the fall.

supervisor.value: Students start with lab rotations and individualized research, so an advisor is not needed before admission.
supervisor.quote: Lab rotations and individualized research tailored to your career interests

funding.value: The page mentions training grants but no funding rule for admitted PhD students.

entry_route.value: The page does not state the degree needed before a PhD.

gre_general.value: The page does not mention GRE; the Graduate School rule is set per department.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: The program is run by the College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences; it uses the Graduate School portal and its fee and waiver rules. The page gives a minimum GPA of 3.0 and three letters of recommendation, but no GRE or English rule of its own. Interview rounds finish March 7.
